Safe methods intend no state changes (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS). Idempotent methods repeat same intended
effect (GET, PUT, DELETE); POST/PATCH not inherently idempotent.

Read the diagram: Response status can differ even when the intended effect is idempotent.
Expected result: The repeated PUT produces the same intended resource state.

Interview question: Is DELETE idempotent if a repeat returns 404?
Answer: Yes, its intended effect of removing the resource remains the same.
Remember: Safe = read intent; idempotent = repeat effect.
